skill.name: plan-harder
skill.description: Creates detailed, phased implementation plans for bugs, features, and tasks when the user asks to plan harder.
skill.summary: Creates phased implementation plans with research, atomic tasks, validation steps, and review.
skill.author: am-will

security_audit.summary: The flagged external command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around filenames and a fenced Markdown template. No executable scripts, shell invocations, network access, environment access, or prompt injection attempts were found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 71 uses Markdown inline code to describe a filename suffix. It is documentation text, not Ruby or shell execution.
Line 74 shows an example Markdown filename in backticks. There is no command invocation or user-controlled execution path.
Line 75 shows another Markdown filename example in backticks. It does not execute code or instruct shell command usage.
Line 92 starts a fenced Markdown plan template. The block is a document template, not executable shell or Ruby code.

content.value_statement: Complex software tasks can fail when scope, sequencing, and validation are unclear. This skill creates phased plans with atomic tasks, checkpoints, risks, and review steps.
actual_capabilities: Researches existing codebase patterns before planning.
Breaks work into phased sprints with demo checkpoints.
Defines atomic tasks with dependencies and validation steps.
Prompts for requirement clarification when scope is unclear.
Saves a Markdown plan file and requests subagent review.
limitations: It creates plans only and should not implement changes.
It depends on the available codebase context and tools.
It may need user answers before finalizing ambiguous scope.
It does not estimate dates or staffing beyond simple complexity labels.

use_cases.title: Feature Planning
use_cases.description: Plan a new feature into phases, tasks, dependencies, and validation steps before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Bug Fix Roadmap
use_cases.description: Turn a complex bug report into investigation steps, fixes, tests, and rollback guidance.

use_cases.title: Delivery Review
use_cases.description: Create a sprint-level plan that exposes risks, prerequisites, and demo checkpoints for team review.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Small Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan harder for adding [small change]. Research the codebase, ask clarifying questions if needed, and create a phased plan file.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a focused enhancement or cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Bug Fix
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan harder for fixing [bug]. Include reproduction research, likely causes, test coverage, validation, risks, and a rollback plan.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when a bug touches several files or behaviors.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Feature Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan harder for implementing [feature]. Include architecture research, phased sprints, dependencies, acceptance criteria, release validation, and operational risks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a feature that needs multiple increments.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a System Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan harder for migrating [system] from [current state] to [target state]. Include constraints, sequencing, compatibility, testing, rollout, and fallback steps.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for high-risk changes with many dependencies.

output_examples.input: Plan harder for adding password reset.
output: A Markdown plan file with research notes, prerequisites, phased sprints, and atomic tasks.
Each task includes dependencies, acceptance criteria, and validation steps.
The plan closes with risks, rollback guidance, and a review pass.

output_examples.input: Plan harder for fixing flaky checkout tests.
output: A bug-focused plan with reproduction steps, investigation tasks, and test validation.
The plan separates diagnosis, repair, regression coverage, and rollout checks.

output_examples.input: Plan harder for migrating the billing service.
output: A migration plan with prerequisites, compatibility checks, phased rollout, and fallback guidance.
Risks and unclear requirements are called out before implementation begins.

best_practices: Provide the target change, constraints, and success criteria in the request.
Answer clarification questions before expecting a final plan.
Review the saved plan for missing dependencies before implementation starts.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for immediate code changes instead of planning.
Skipping research when the requested change touches unfamiliar areas.
Treating complexity estimates as delivery commitments.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it when a task needs research, phased execution, or stronger validation before implementation.

faq.question: Does it write code?
faq.answer: No. It creates a plan and explicitly avoids implementation.

faq.question: What format does it produce?
faq.answer: It saves a Markdown plan with overview, prerequisites, sprints, tasks, tests, risks, and rollback notes.

faq.question: Can it ask questions?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses clarification questions when scope, priorities, or constraints are unclear.

faq.question: Does it review the plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks a subagent to review the saved plan and incorporates useful feedback.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
